values: Source: new_hw/INSTRUCTION_FORMAT.md and current IF/AGU/EXE decoder behavior.
Instruction index, not a byte address. The first three template addresses are preserved. Enter each active address once.
OB write buffer: 0 or 1. Selection follows this instruction through to the NL store.
Select one OSP bank for MLOM. Upper four selector bits go to 62:59; lower two go to 4:3.
0 leaves the loop count unchanged, except a taken CLP decrements it. A nonzero value loads the count and takes priority over that decrement.
1 saves the current instruction address plus 1 as the loop-back target.
1 requests a jump to the saved breakpoint when the previously stored iteration count is nonzero.
Absolute IB read-buffer selection: 0 or 1. Does not reset the IB pointer.
Signed relative change. Negative: sign bit 50 = 1 and magnitude = ABS(delta). Nonnegative: sign = 0. Pointer wraps modulo 1024.
Absolute KSP read-buffer selection: 0 or 1. Shared by all 64 lanes; does not reset the pointer.
Signed relative change. Sign at bit 38, 8-bit absolute magnitude at 37:30. Shared pointer wraps modulo 256.
Signed relative change. Sign at bit 29, 9-bit absolute magnitude at 28:20. Pointer wraps modulo 512; the address is pipelined for OSP stores.
Signed relative change. Sign at bit 19, 6-bit absolute magnitude at 18:13. Pointer wraps modulo 64.
1 requests an IB read at the calculated IF address, qualified by the memory enable.
1 requests KSP reads at the shared calculated IF address, qualified per lane.
1 requests OSP reads. A store to the same physical bank on that edge takes priority; there is no automatic retry.
1 requests a BSP read; its result can be captured by MLB at ML-to-EXE.
Multiplier input 1: 0 selects zero; 1 selects MLI.
Multiplier input 2: 0 selects fixed-point unity; 1 selects MLK.
0 = zero; 1 = MLO; 2 = EOA. Encoding 3 is reserved by the current instruction specification.
0 = MAC. Encoding 1 selects the currently unimplemented MAX mode and is flagged by Field check.
1 requests an NL OSP store using the instruction's pipelined OSP address and enabled EOA lanes.
1 stores the dummy LUT result into the selected OB buffer and advances the shared 10-bit OB pointer by 1.
Description for the schedule and future Python assembler; it is not an instruction field.
Ready means the entered fields are complete and supported. It does not check execution timing or buffer ownership.
Fill all 21 controls in columns B:V. Enter 0 explicitly for a control you do not use.
Leave B:V blank. An unused row is not automatically an instruction or a pipeline bubble.
For -3, encode sign 1 and magnitude 3. For 0 or a positive value, encode sign 0.
All four deltas update on every issued instruction, even with Load=0. Buffer changes and SCR do not reset pointers.
ACC 3 is reserved. MAX/MAC 1 selects the unimplemented MAX path. Both are flagged.
An OSP store occurs three edges after IF issue. A same-edge read of that bank loses to the write.
All-zero controls perform a zero-result MAC and update EOA. They do not preserve the accumulator.
Use one 64-bit hexadecimal instruction (16 text digits) per line in the slave IMEM file.
Encoding and .mem export belong in Python. The worksheet validates fields and does not generate .mem files.
Field check covers values and active address uniqueness. Validate pipeline dependencies and bank ownership separately.
Set IB select=1, KSP select=1, Load IB=1, Load KSP=1, MULT1=1, MULT2=1, Store OSP=1.
Set remaining controls to 0. IB/KSP delta=0 reads word 0 after pointer reset.
Set OB select=1, OSP mux=37, BSP delta=37, Load OSP=1, Load BSP=1, Store OB=1.
Set remaining controls to 0. PCs 8, 9 and 10 are explicit delay instructions in the current test.
